caption_L1: This area diagram is labeled U.S. potato production from 2000 to 2019 (in 1,000 cwt). There is a linear scale of range 2000 to 2015 along the x-axis, marked Year. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 500,000 can be seen along the y-axis, marked Production in thousand cwt.
caption_L2L3: The visualization chart shows that during the period between 2000 and 2019 the U.S. has produced at least 400,000 cwt of potatoes every year. Between 2000 and 2019, the year 2000 had the highest yield of potatoes, with 500,000 cwt of potatoes grown in the U.S. During the ten year period between 2000 and 2010, the potato yield in the U.S. declined from 500,000 down to a low of 400,000.
